items.text: Ekiro kikuru ky'Omukate Ogutatumbisiibwe, ekyetwa Pasika kikaba kiraliire kugoba.
Aho abakuhani bakuru n'abeegesa b'Amateka bashangwa nibahiga okwo baraita Yesu. Kyonkai bakaba nibatina abantu.
Aho Sitani abanda Yuda Isikariote ayabaire ali omoiho omw'ikumi na babili.
Akwata omuhanda agenda afumora n'abakuhani bakuru n'abakuru b'abalinzi ba Rwensinga okwo arashobora kumubakwasa.
Bashemelerwa mara bagamba kumuha empiha.
Kityo Yuda aikiliza mara ahiiga obushango bw'okumubakwasa embaga etaliho.
Omu biro bikuru by'Omukate Ogutatumbisiibwe nimwo baitiraga akataama k'okulya ahali Pasika.
Aho Yesu atuma Petero na Yohana nabaragira ati, “Mugende mututekatekere Pasika twije tugilye.”
Bamubaza bati, “Nogonza tugitekateke nkahai?”
Abahorora ati, “Orwo murataha omu kigo muratanganwa omuntu ayetwekire emuga y'amaizi. Mumuhondere. Enju ey'aratahamu mube nimwo mutaha.
Mugambire mukama w'enju muti, ‘Omwegesa nakuubaza ekiyumba ky'abagenyi mbali aralira Pasika hamoi n'abegesibwabe.’
Araboleka ekiyumba kihango omu gorofa kyatekatekirwe, omwo mube nimwo mushemeza.”
Bagenda babishanga okwo yabibagambira. Batekateka Pasika.
Orwo esaa yagobire, Yesu ashuntama n'abegesibwabe kuragira.
Abagambira ati, “Mbaire nayegombire kulya Pasika hamoi nainywe ntakashasire.
Mbagambirege, tindishuba kugilya rundi kuhika orwo elimanyika enshonga yayo omu Bukama bwa Ruhanga.”
Akwata ekikompe. Kayamazire kusiima agamba ati, “Mutore ekikompe eki munyweho inywena.
Kambagambire: Tinkishuba kunywa divai kulemwa kugoba orwo Obukama bwa Ruhanga buligobelera.”
Akwata n'omukate. Kayamazire kusiima, agubegura, agubaha nagamba ati, “Ogu mubili gwange ogulikwija kutambilirwa inywe. [Mukorega mutyo okunyijukiraho.”
Kabamazire kuragira akwata ekikompe nagamba ati, “Eki kikompe ky'obwamba bwange oburashesheka aha rwanyu, niyo ndagano empya y'obwamba bwange.]
Kyonkai muraleba, alikwija kumbanja ataire omukono aha meza nitulya hamoi.
Omwana w'Omuntu naija kuba nk'okwo kyakahangirwe. Kyonkai alikwija kumubanja alibona!”
Aho abegesibwa babanza kubazangana bonene bonkai, kumanya n'ohai omuli bonene alikwija kukora atyo.
Omu begesibwa haimukwamu empaka, benzire kumanya omukuru kushaaga bona n'ohai.
Yesu abagambira ati, “Abakama b'abanyamahanga abatwarwa babo babatwaza eikama. Kandi abatwazi benda kwetwa ‘Ngonza z'abantu.’
Kyonkai omuli inywe bitaliba bityo. Omukuru wanyu bwoli abe n'iwe aba muto wanyu bwoli. Omutwazi abe mukozi wanyu.
N'ohai omukuru kushaaga ondijo: Ayashuntama kulya anga omukoziwe? Manya omukuru n'ogwo ayashuntama kulya. Kyonkai inye omuli inywe mba mukozi.
“Inywe ninywe mwangumireho omu matangwa gange.
Nk'okwo Tata yampaire obukama nanye kwakwo nimbubaha,
mwije omu bukama bwange mulye, munywe, mushuntamire enketo muramure amahanga 12 ga Isiraeli.
“Simoni, Simoni! Sitani ashabire muno kuberura nk'engano.
Kyonkai inye nkushabiire okwesiga kwawe kutakuyuga. Kandi iwe k'oraba wangarukireho, barumuna bawe orabagumisa.”
Petero agambira Yesu ati, “Mukama wange, inye nibatufunga hamoi, n'okufa nitufa hamoi.”
Yesu agamba ati, “Kankugambire Petero, kir'eki enkoko etakakokoromire, oraba wanyetongire kashatu okw'otalikummanya.”
Yesu abaza abegesibwabe ati, “Orwo nabatumire mukagenda mutaina nfulebe ya mpiha anga mufuko anga nbiratwa, mwina ekyababuzireho?” Bahorora bati, “Tikiliho.”
Aho abagambira ati, “Mbwenu araba aina enfulebe y'empiha agikwate; n'omufuko kutyo. Kandi ataina mbanda aguze ebeboye agure embanda.
Kambagambire, ekyahandikirwe kyaija kugobeelera omu birabaho, bati, ‘Bakamukwatirana n'abafakare.’ Manyasi ebyo bampandikireho nibija kugobeelera.”
Abegesibwa bagamba bati, “Rugaba, waitu leba embanda niz'ezi ibili.” Yesu abagambira ati, “Katulekelere aho.”
Yesu aturuka, agya aha Ibanga ly'Emizeituni nk'okwo yakagiraga. Abegesibwabe bamuhondera.
Kayagobireyo abagambira ati, “Mushome enshara, mutakugwa mu bilengeso.”
Abarugaho akatambi akasaine mbali wakurasha eibare likagoba, abandama, ashoma enshara ati,
“Tata, k'oraba noyenda onjune ekikompe eki. Kyonkai tikwo inye ndikwenda, shana okwo iwe olikwenda kibe nikwo kiba.” [
Aho omumalaika aruga omw'iguru amubonekera kumugumisa.
Kayabaire ali omu kubanganwa omwoyo ashoma enshara n'amani gangi kushagaho. Ahitana empita elikushusha amatonya g'obwamba, empita egyo emagalika ahansi.]
Kayarugire kushoma enshara, agoba abegesibwabe ashanga banagiziibwe obujune.
Ababaza ati, “Kiki nka mwanagira? Mwimuke mushome enshara mutaija mukagwa omu bilengeso.”
Yesu kayabaire akyali omu kugamba atyo, aijwa embaga eyebembeirwe omuntu alikwetwa Yuda, omoiho omw'ikumi na babili. Ailira ahali Yesu kumunywegera.
Kyonkai Yesu amubaza ati, “Iwe Yuda, nonywegera Omwana w'Omuntu kumubanja?”
Abo yabaire ainabo kabaaboine ebyaija kubaho, babaza Yesu bati, “Rugaba, waitu tutemese embanda?”
Omuli bonene harugwamu omoi agiteza omwiru w'Omukuhani Nyamukuru amutemaho okutwi kwa bulyo.
Kyonkai Yesu amugambira ati, “Lekelera aho!” Akwata omwiru ogwo okutwi amukiza.
Yesu abaza abakuhani bakuru, n'abakuru ba Rwensinga, n'abagurusi ababaire bamuzinzire, ati, “Mwanzinda nk'omushuga, mwaija n'embanda n'enkoni z'erungu?
Orwo nkasiiba nainywe buli kiro omuli Rwensinga timukankwataga. Kyonkai mbwenu esaa yanyu niy'egi orwo mwina amani g'omwilima.”
Bakwata Yesu bamukurukumbya bamutwete ow'Omukuhani Nyamukuru. Petero amuhondera nasigara enyuma.
K'abantu babaire bahembire omuliro omu ndaragati ya nyakabuga, bakashuntama kwota, Petero nawe abashuntamamu.
Omuzana kayamuboine okwo ashuntamire aha muliro, amulebage amwekomya, agamba ati, “Omushaija ogu nawe yaba aina Yesu.”
Kyonkai Petero ayetonga okwo yaba ainawe, agamba ati, “Iwe mukazi, Yesu ogwo tindikumumanya.”
Ahanyuma kake omuntu ondijo nawe amubona, agamba ati, “Naiwe kwakwo oli wabo.” Kyonkai Petero ahorora ati, “Iwe mushaija, inye tindi wabo.”
Esaa ehinguraho nk'emoi, omuntu ondijo aija ataho akakumu ati, “Mazima, omushaija ogu nawe yaba aina Yesu; aha rw'okuba Munyagalilaya.”
Ndi Petero ahorora ati, “Iwe mushaija tindikumanya by'olikugamba.” Orwo yabaire akyagamba atyo, enkoko ekookoroma.
Omukama akubuka aleba Petero. Petero aijuka ekigambo ky'Omukama, okwo yabaire amugambiire ati, “Kir'eki enkoko etakakokoromire, oranyetonga kashatu.”
Nikwo Petero kuturuka aheru akalira muno.
Abashaija ababaire bakwete Yesu bamujaamya, bamutera.
Bashuba bamubunda aha maisho bamugambira bati, “Baasha! Ayakutera n'ohai?”
Bamurogotaho n'ebindi bingi, bamushekelera.
K'obwire bwakeire abagurusi b'embaga bahurura, abakuhani bakuru n'abeegesa b'Amateka babulimu. Bamutwara omu rukiko, bagamba bati,
“K'oraba oli Kirisito otugambire.” Yesu abagambira ati, “Kandabagambira timunyikilize,
kandi kandababaza timumporore.
Kyonkai kuruga mambwenu Omwana w'Omuntu naija kusingira aha bulyo bwa Ruhanga Omushoborabyona.”
Bona bamubaza bati, “Ahosi iwe oli mwana wa Ruhanga?” Yesu abahorora ati, “Inywe n'inywe mwakigamba okwo ndiwe.”
Bagamba bati, “Tukyayetaga bujuliziki obushagiire aha? Ekyo yagamba twakyehulilira nikiruga omu kanwake.”
